saveFilter.wav.description: File type name in the save dialog for a WAV export.

presetFile.saveTitle.description: Title of the dialog that saves presets to a file.

presetFile.openTitle.description: Title of the dialog that opens a preset file.

confirm.cancel.description: Cancel button of a confirmation in a translated UI.

updates.disabled.description: Settings › About › Updates: this build of Flown does not update itself (a build made without the update feed).

updates.never.description: Settings › About › Updates: no check has run since Flown was installed.

updates.upToDate.description: Settings › About › Updates: the last check found nothing newer.

updates.checking.description: Settings › About › Updates: a check is running.

updates.checkFailed.description: Settings › About › Updates: the check failed.

updates.downloadFailed.description: Settings › About › Updates: the download failed and automatic updates will try again. Main sets it; the page tells it apart from the manual form below by its text, so both come from this catalogue.

updates.downloadFailedManual.description: Settings › About › Updates: the download failed and automatic updates are off.

updates.notReady.description: Restart now was asked for, but no update is downloaded.

updates.available.description: Settings › About › Updates: a newer version exists; {version} is its number ("0.7.2").

updates.downloadingPercent.description: Settings › About › Updates: the download’s progress in percent.

updates.ready.description: Settings › About › Updates and Home’s title bar: an update is downloaded.

updates.downloading.description: Settings › About › Updates: what screen readers hear while the update downloads (without the percent); also the progress bar’s name.

busy.recording.description: Why Flown cannot restart now (to install an update or change language): a recording is running.

busy.processing.description: Why Flown cannot restart now: a finished recording is still being saved or processed.

busy.export.description: Why Flown cannot restart now: an export is running.

busy.captions.description: Why Flown cannot restart now: captions are being made.

busy.analysis.description: Why Flown cannot restart now: the sound is being analysed.

busy.import.description: Why Flown cannot restart now: a video is being imported.

busy.voice.description: Why Flown cannot restart now: Clean voice is working. "Clean voice" is the feature’s name.

busy.copy.description: Why Flown cannot restart now: a project is being copied.

busy.share.description: Why Flown cannot restart now: a video is being shared.
